definition.name: Fresh Java resources across ordinary timer callbacks and two tenants

steps.name: Fetch only the exact authenticated native observer source
Check resource capture, explicit authority and actual pending refusal controls
steps.run:
python3 -m pip install --requirement tools/requirements.lock
python3 -B -m unittest tools.tests.test_java_joined_resources tools.tests.test_java_joined_runtime tools.tests.test_java_joined_owners tools.tests.test_sdk_native_products_reader -v

steps.name: Authenticate the five retained native products without rebuilding them
Install the existing pinned Java guest compiler tools
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
curl --fail --location --retry 3 --max-time 180 \
  https://services.gradle.org/distributions/gradle-9.1.0-bin.zip \
  -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/gradle.zip"
echo "a17ddd85a26b6a7f5ddb71ff8b05fc5104c0202c6e64782429790c933686c806  $RUNNER_TEMP/gradle.zip" | sha256sum --check --strict
unzip -q "$RUNNER_TEMP/gradle.zip" -d "$RUNNER_TEMP"
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/gradle-9.1.0/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
curl --fail --location --max-time 180 \
  https://github.com/WebAssembly/wasi-sdk/releases/download/wasi-sdk-29/wasi-sdk-29.0-x86_64-linux.tar.gz \
  -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk.tar.gz"
echo "87d1d1a2879d139cdc624b968efad3d4a97b8078cdff95e63ac88ecafd1a0171  $RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --strict
tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk.tar.gz" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP"
python3 -B tools/install_guest_bindgen.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-resource-bindgen"
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-resource-bindgen" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

steps.name: Capture two ordinary JARs and sign one fresh joined Java component
Retain public compiler identities and bounded node outcomes

with.name: java-resource-runtime-${{ github.sha }}
with.path:
${{ runner.temp }}/java-resource-native/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/java-resource-runtime/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/java-resource-runtime/commands/logs/**
${{ runner.temp }}/java-resource-runtime/compiler/compiler-cache-selection.json
${{ runner.temp }}/java-resource-runtime/build/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/java-resource-runtime/build/compiler-logs/**
${{ runner.temp }}/java-resource-runtime/build/component.wasm
${{ runner.temp }}/java-resource-runtime/build/capsule.json
${{ runner.temp }}/java-resource-runtime/build/package/**
${{ runner.temp }}/java-resource-runtime/node/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/java-resource-runtime/node/node-stderr.txt
${{ runner.temp }}/java-resource-runtime/node/commands/logs/**
${{ runner.temp }}/java-resource-runtime/node/examples-controls/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/java-resource-runtime/node/foreign-controls/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/java-resource-runtime/node/signed/my-greeting/build-observation.json
${{ runner.temp }}/java-resource-runtime/node/signed/release-set.json
